brief:
The head of the northern Hebron chamber, Mahmoud Allan, toured the Beit Amr popular heritage market, the Ma'an news agency reported. The inspection aimed to assess conditions at the marketplace, which preserves traditional Palestinian commerce and crafts in the area.

Allan's visit follows ongoing local efforts to monitor and support heritage sites and traditional markets in the northern Hebron region.
title: Mahmoud Allan inspects Beit Amr's heritage market in northern Hebron
